records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:

draft.subject: Re: SSO setup — and your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks again for your SSO question — your ticket is still open on our side, and I'll stay on it with you. As I mentioned, SSO is available on the Team plan, and I'm happy to answer anything else about how it would work for Union Labs.

Separately, you've got your first project created and one invite out. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that's where the value usually starts showing up for a team.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through whatever's blocking the next step.

Best,
Chidi
